title: brachiaria piligera
intro: Brachiaria piligera, commonly known as Khas or Khas-khas, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Brachiaria piligera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
